title: Ship it before it is perfect

scenes.say: Perfect is how good ideas die quietly.
scenes.visual: a dusty laptop closed on a desk in a dark room

scenes.say: The first version is supposed to be rough.
scenes.visual: a rough pencil sketch on paper next to a cup of coffee

scenes.say: You learn more from one real customer than a month of planning.
scenes.visual: two people talking across a counter in a small shop

scenes.say: So put it out while it still scares you.
scenes.visual: a finger about to press a key on a laptop keyboard, close up

scenes.say: Fix it in public. Improve it every week.
scenes.visual: a man working late at a desk with one lamp, city lights through the window

scenes.say: Done and live beats perfect and hidden.
scenes.visual: a small shop front with its lights on at night on a quiet street

scenes.say: Follow for more. Build every day.
scenes.visual: sunrise over a city seen through an office window

caption: Ship it before it is perfect. Fix it in public.
